description: A known lyric document's words forced onto a vocal stem (--stem stems/vocals) by torchaudio's WAV2VEC2_ASR_BASE_960H CTC character model, in one pass with a free token at every line boundary, and each word split into syllables by Pyphen en_US 2/2 with a vowel-group fallback. Run by request by `enrich align-lyrics`, never by the feature-bank runner (ADR 0085, amendment of 2026-11-27). Runs under the operator's align-python with the checkpoint in the operator's align-weights directory, so the archive's environment never imports PyTorch and ships no weights.
requires: wav2vec2_fairseq_base_ls960_asr_ls960.pth sha256:488fd4f16de84438ffc945334278c1b9fb9b7159a806c1080b16111a958c945d (fairseq wav2vec 2.0 base, LibriSpeech 960 h CTC; MIT), in the align-weights directory

parameters.pass: the whole document in one pass over the whole stem, no line anchors; a free * token (log probability 0) at every line boundary, | between words
parameters.text: NFKD, combining marks dropped, lower case a-z and the apostrophe (a leading or trailing apostrophe dropped), a word of digits alone spelled out
parameters.syllabification: the document word's code points, each spelled as its letters (NFKD, combining marks dropped, lower case a-z and the apostrophe); Pyphen en_US left=2 right=2 on the letters, and where it keeps the word whole a cut between vowel groups (before the consonant of one, after the first of several), a silent final e (not -le) and a plain -es (not after s, z, x, ch, sh, c, g) making no vowel group of their own; a cut inside one code point's letters moves to its end; a word of digits alone is one syllable
parameters.syllable_start: the frame of the syllable's first letter
parameters.confidence: mean CTC posterior probability of the aligned letters, 0 to 1, to 3 places

alignment.description: the document's lines (by number, as World counts them) and words (by number in the line) with letters the model spells: start and end samples at 16 kHz, mean letter probability as decimal text, and each word's syllables by code point offsets into the word, each with its start sample and its end (the next syllable's start, the last the word's end); no character of the document

mean_score.description: mean CTC posterior of every aligned letter, decimal text to 3 places; below the command's gate the alignment is lost

active_seconds.description: seconds of the stem the silence gate kept and the model read, decimal text
